digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler coordinator and mutation orchestration
propositions: Jira mutation retries are scattered across multiple subsystems (differ, apply wrapper, handlers, batch orchestration) with no unified ownership model, allowing logical postconditions to replay across nested loops and terminal failures to lack stable per-ticket scope.
No current endpoint-failure circuit breaker exists; the reconciler's blast-radius guard is a per-pass mass-mutation fraction check, not a consecutive-failure or endpoint-family fuse.

Each logical postcondition must complete within three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, with provider Retry-After honored as a lower bound and long waits deferred via retry_not_before.

A new endpoint-family scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted eligible logical outcomes across at least two tickets, independent of and complementary to the retained blast-radius protection.

Create containment must enforce label-first ordering (rebar-id:<local_id>), optional property enrichment, and safety-abort on known-key collision without duplicate creates after timeout or persistence failure.

Shadow planning must produce immutable per-ticket plans with testable selection, caps, dependencies, diagnostics, dispositions, mutations, and lifecycle intents without remote or local effects, enabling safe cutover by operation family.
